Google Cloud previews Gemini for healthcare

• Google Cloud launched a preview of Gemini for healthcare to unify clinical data and reduce administrative workload.
• Anthropic set its IPO price range at $70 to $78 per share, targeting a $1.404 trillion valuation.
• Anthropic's S-1 filing shows each of its seven founders will sell 3,378,378 shares in its upcoming IPO.

Anthropic sets $70-$78 IPO price for $1.4T valuation.

• Anthropic offers 825 million shares to raise up to $64.35 billion.
• Google and Nvidia each invest $10 billion in non-voting stock.
• Trading starts on Nasdaq near November 19 after market pullback.

Our read: Major tech giants are betting billions on Anthropic's future, signaling strong AI market confidence.
